aesthetic: Papier Confronté — warm cotton stock as ground, every zone collision deliberate, every white breath earned against a press-ink signal that migrates from left to right across 44 individually composed pages
chromaticArc: Slides 1–11 breathe in amber and cotton white with golden accent bars; slides 12–24 introduce vermillion signal elements against warm vellum; slides 25–35 shift to atlas-blue bars and cold white grounds; slides 36–44 close in prussian night accents on aged ivory, the warmth drained to a cool, considered finish — two section-divider slides (near slide 14 and slide 28) flip to press-ink backgrounds as tonal shocks.
gridStrategy: Every slide invents a unique gravitational axis — title may anchor bottom-left at row 28 while a label floats top-right, or a full-bleed column occupies only col 38–57 while the left 38 columns hold negative space; no two consecutive slides share the same dominant zone quadrant, forcing the eye to re-orient at every turn.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on reflective or narrative slides (roughly every 4th–5th slide) where body text carries emotional weight and the title drops to weight 300; Courier New is reserved for data-dense, list, or measurement slides where monospace rhythm signals precision over declaration

accentStrategy: Every slide carries exactly one structural accent bar (width 4–8 col, height 1–5 rows) whose column position advances by approximately 1.3 columns per slide — a slow left-to-right diagonal migration across all 44 slides — supplemented on 55% of slides by a secondary colour block or 12px dot anchoring the compositionally opposite corner to create cross-slide visual counterpoint.
